newsitem.title: USA: AMERICAN BANKNOTE TO PRINT INDIAN BANK NOTES. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: AMERICAN BANKNOTE TO PRINT INDIAN BANK NOTES. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]

text.p: American Banknote Corp said Monday it will generate $14 million in revenues over the next year for printing more than 500 million bank notes for the Reserve Bank of India (corrects to show that American Banknote will print more than 500 million banknotes).

The company said the 100 rupee notes will contain a number of high-security and anti-counterfeiting measures. It added production will start at its Tennessee plant this summer for initial deliveries in October.
American Banknote earned $2.2 million on revenues of $79.2 million in the quarter ended June 30, compared with a $1.4 million net on revenues of $70.8 million in the second quarter of 1996.
The company's stock closed at 4-9/16 Friday.
